messages.content: aaj ammi abbu ki phir larai hui, main kamre mein band hoon aur rona aa raha hai.

Ammi abbu ki larai sun kar kamre mein band ho jana bohat bura lagta hai, aur rona aana bilkul fitri hai. Aap ki koi ghalti nahi ke woh larte hain. Kya aap ke paas koi hai jis se aap abhi baat kar sakte hain, ya thori der ke liye kuch aisa kar sakte hain jis se dil halka ho?
sab doston ki job lag gayi, sirf main reh gaya hoon. khud ko nakara lagta hai.

Jab sab dost aage badh jayein aur aap wahin khade hon to khud ko nakara samajhna samajh aata hai, lekin job ka der se lagna aap ki qeemat ka faisla nahi karta. Har kisi ka waqt alag hota hai. Aap kis tarah ki job dhoond rahe hain, aur ab tak sab se mushkil hissa kya raha hai?
shaadi ko do saal ho gaye, miyan biwi mein baat hi nahi hoti ab. bas zimmedariyan reh gayi hain.

Shaadi mein jab baat cheet kam ho jaye aur sirf zimmedariyan reh jayein to aksar akelapan mehsoos hota hai, chahe koi saath hi kyun na ho. Yeh kai logon ke saath hota hai, aur is par baat karna pehla qadam hai. Aap ko sab se zyada kis cheez ki kami mehsoos hoti hai, saath waqt guzarne ki, baat karne ki, ya kuch aur?
exam mein achhe number aye! pehli dafa lag raha hai mehnat rang layi.

Wah, bohat bohat mubarak ho! Mehnat ka rang laana bohat khoobsurat ehsaas hota hai, aur aap ne yeh khud kamaya hai. Is lamhe ko thora mehsoos karein, aap iske haqdar hain. Aap ke khayal mein is dafa aisa kya alag kiya jis ne farq dala?
yaar mera cat bimaar hai, vet ne kaha operation hoga, bohat pareshan hoon.

Apne cat ka bimaar hona aur operation ki khabar sunna bohat pareshan kun hai, woh ghar ka hissa hota hai. Aap ki fikar bilkul samajh aati hai. Vet ne operation ke baare mein kya bataya, aur aap ko sab se zyada kis baat ka dar hai?
jab bhi phone dekhta hoon sab ki perfect life nazar aati hai, apni zindagi bekaar lagti hai.

Phone par sab ki perfect zindagi dekh kar apni zindagi feeki lagna bohat aam hai, kyunke log sirf apne achhe lamhe dikhate hain. Lekin yeh ehsaas phir bhi chubhta hai. Kya aap ne notice kiya hai ke kis waqt ya kin accounts ko dekh kar yeh sab se zyada hota hai?
roza rakh ke office jana aur phir iftar ki tayyari, thak ke choor ho gayi hoon.

Roza rakh kar office jana aur phir iftar ki tayyari karna waqai bohat thaka dene wala hai, aap poora din chal rahi hain. Aap ki thakan bilkul jaiz hai. Kya ghar mein koi aur iftar ki tayyari mein haath bata sakta hai, taake aap ko thora aaram mil sake?
abbu ki tabiyat kharab hai aur hospital ke chakkar laga laga ke dimagh kaam nahi kar raha.

Abbu ki bimaari aur hospital ke chakkar, yeh jismani aur zehni dono tarah se bohat bhari hota hai. Aise waqt mein dimagh ka thak jana bilkul samajh aata hai. Kya koi aur rishtedaar hai jo baari baari hospital mein saath de sake, taake sara bojh aap par na ho?
mujhe gussa bohat jaldi aa jata hai, phir baad mein pachtawa hota hai.

Yeh achhi baat hai ke aap is par ghaur kar rahe hain, kyunke gussa aane ke baad pachtawa hona batata hai ke aap rishton ki parwah karte hain. Aksar gussa kisi aur thakan ya pareshani ka ishara hota hai. Kya aap ko yaad hai ke haal hi mein kis baat par sab se zyada gussa aya tha?
hostel mein roommate bohat shor karta hai, parhai nahi ho pa rahi.

Parhai ke waqt shor bohat frustrating hota hai, khaas taur par jab exam qareeb hon. Kya aap ne roommate se araam se baat ki hai, ya kuch ghante tay kiye ja sakte hain jab kamra khamosh rahe? Tab tak library ya headphones bhi thora kaam aa sakte hain.
Presentation acchi gayi but ab bhi dil dhak dhak kar raha hai lol.

Wah, mubarak ho ke presentation achhi gayi! Dil ka ab bhi dhak dhak karna normal hai, adrenaline itni jaldi nahi utarta. Thori der aaram se saans lein aur khud ko shabash dein. Aap ko sab se achha kaunsa hissa laga?
Meri best friend ne mujhe apni birthday par invite hi nahi kiya, I feel so left out.

Yeh sun kar bura laga, best friend ki birthday par invite na hona sach mein chubhta hai aur left out mehsoos karna bilkul samajh aata hai. Ho sakta hai koi wajah ho, lekin dukh phir bhi hota hai. Kya aap us se is baare mein baat karna chahenge, ya pehle thora sochna chahenge ke kya kehna hai?
garmi se jaan nikal gayi aaj, aur AC bhi kharab.

Garmi aur upar se AC kharab, yeh to waqai imtihan hai! Aise din mein kuch bhi karna mushkil lagta hai. Thanda pani piyen aur agar mumkin ho to kisi thandi jagah chale jayen. Kya AC theek karwane ka koi intezam ho raha hai?
mummy ne mere phone ka bill dekh liya, ab to main gaya kaam se.

Haha, phone ka bill aur mummy ki nazar, yeh combination waqai darawna hai! Ghabrahat samajh aati hai. Shayad pehle khud baat kar lena behtar ho, saaf bata dein ke bill itna kyun aya aur aage kaise control karenge. Aap ke khayal mein mummy kitni naraz hongi?
kal ka paper dekh ke laga main to mar hi jaunga, itna mushkil tha.

Itna mushkil paper dekh kar ghabra jana bilkul samajh aata hai, aisa lagta hai saari tayyari kaam hi nahi aayi. Lekin aksar paper ke baad jo mehsoos hota hai, result us se behtar nikalta hai. Kaunsa hissa sab se zyada mushkil laga, aur kya aap ne jitna yaad tha woh likh diya?
My boss is going to kill me when he sees this spreadsheet.

That sinking feeling before someone sees your work is so stressful. Is it a mistake you can still fix, or something you'll need to explain? If there's time, it might help to flag the problem to him first, along with how you plan to sort it; bosses usually react better when they hear it from you. What went wrong with the spreadsheet?
I want to die of embarrassment, I called my teacher mum in front of the whole class.

Oh no, that's such a universal nightmare, and honestly one of the most common slips people make with teachers. It feels mortifying in the moment, but most classmates will have forgotten by next week, even if you won't for a while. How did your teacher react?
chhota bhai har cheez mein aage hai aur ghar walay har baat par mera muqabla us se karte hain.

Har baat par apne bhai se muqabla hona bohat thaka dene wala aur dil dukhane wala hota hai, jaise aap ki apni koshishen nazar hi na aati hon. Yeh kab se ho raha hai, aur kis baat par sab se zyada chubhta hai?
kal result aya to abbu ne kaha dekho bhai ke kitne number aye, tumhare kyun nahi.

Result ke din yeh sunna sach mein takleef deh hai, khaas taur par jab aap ne pehle hi bataya ke har baat par muqabla hota hai. Aap ki mehnat aur aap ki pehchan bhai ke numberon se nahi naapi ja sakti. Kya aap ne kabhi abbu ko bataya hai ke yeh muqabla aap ko kaisa mehsoos karwata hai?
I've been putting off my thesis for weeks and I hate myself for it.

That cycle of avoiding something and then feeling awful about it is really painful, and the self-criticism usually makes it even harder to start. You're clearly someone who cares about doing it well. What part of the thesis feels hardest to face right now?
My supervisor just emailed asking for chapter two by Friday and I have nothing.

That email must have made your stomach drop, especially after weeks of feeling stuck. Friday is tight, but it might be workable if we shrink the goal: an outline plus a rough first section is far better than nothing. It could also help to reply to your supervisor honestly and ask what they need most by Friday. Would you like to break chapter two into smaller pieces together?
Aaj 3 months baad gym gaya, finally!
Wah, yeh bohat achhi baat hai! Teen mahine ke gap ke baad wapas jana aasaan nahi hota, aur aap ne pehla qadam utha liya. Kaisa laga aaj, jism ko bhi aur dil ko bhi?
Achha tha but sab log dekh rahe the, I felt so awkward.

Yeh ehsaas bohat aam hai, khaas taur par lambe waqfe ke baad. Aksar lagta hai sab dekh rahe hain, lekin zyada tar log apni workout mein masroof hote hain. Aap ne phir bhi wahan jaa kar poora session kiya, yeh asal baat hai. Kya agli dafa kisi kam rush wale waqt jaana behtar rahega?
kuch dinon se khana peena chhor diya hai, bhook hi nahi lagti.
Yeh sun kar mujhe fikar hui. Kuch dinon tak bhook na lagna aksar is baat ka ishara hota hai ke andar bohat kuch chal raha hai. Kya kuch aisa hua hai jis ki wajah se aap itne pareshan hain?
kya faida khane ka. jeene ka dil hi nahi karta ab.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap itna bojh mehsoos kar rahe hain, aur mujhe aap ki fikar hai. Aap ne bataya ke kuch dinon se khana peena bhi chhor diya hai, aur ab jeene ka dil nahi karta. Kya aap apni zindagi khatam karne ka soch rahe hain? Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par din raat muft baat ho sakti hai. Main yahan hoon aur sun rahi hoon.
Ghar walon pe burden ban gaya hoon, sometimes I think about just ending it.

I'm really glad you told me, aur mujhe aap ki fikar hai. Burden hone ka ehsaas bohat bhari hota hai, aur aksar yeh dard bolta hai, sach nahi. Kya aap abhi apni jaan lene ka soch rahe hain? Please Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par baat karein, yeh 24/7 free hai. Kya hua hai jis se aap ko aisa lagne laga?
dost ne dhoka diya, naukri bhi gayi. ab jeene ka koi maqsad nahi, khud ko khatam karne ka plan bana raha hoon.

Mujhe afsos hai ke ek saath itna kuch toot gaya, dost ka dhoka aur naukri dono. Jab aap khud ko khatam karne ke plan ki baat karte hain to mujhe bohat fikar hoti hai. Please abhi kisi se baat karein: Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par 24 ghante muft, aur agar aap abhi khatre mein hain to 1122 par call karein. Kya aap abhi akele hain?
